responses.verdict: methodology: sound epistemic labels, flawed objective structure (equal weights + non-orthogonal partition); correction: confirmed correct and material

responses.q1_methodology: Equal 0.20 NOT defensible as primary decision structure: implies compensability between non-interchangeable dimensions; capability/reliability are hard gates. Fix: lexicographic objective (satisfy gates, then min time/cost with explicit trade-off rule; intervention potential as secondary criterion); equal weights OK only as descriptive dashboard weights. NOT orthogonal: category error (capability/reliability=outcomes; time/cost=resources; levers=controllable inputs); reliability consumes time/cost; fix = separate decision variables / performance outcomes / resource constraints / feasibility gates, explicit causal DAG. S-a/S-b/S-c useful but insufficient: classifies evidence-acquisition requirements, not evidence quality; add provenance/measurement-uncertainty/sample-size/reproducibility fields; S-c should report interval + decision threshold + what observation would resolve it.
responses.q2_correction: CORRECT and important. Two different contrasts: +0.182 = S5-S0 prompt-level ablation (n=15/arm, local judge); +0.025 = SM arm's own measured effect (p~0.32, n.s.). Attributing +0.182 to SM arm = treatment-attribution error, not labeling inconsistency. Material: overstates SM evidence ~7.3x, distorts expected capability, intervention prioritization, time-to-threshold, cost-effectiveness. Qualification: p~0.32 does not establish SM effect is zero, only insufficient evidence at conventional significance. Required correction: preserve +0.182 under prompt-level ablation; attribute +0.025 to SM arm; no transfer.
responses.verdict: methodology: equal weights + partition fail as decision structure, lexicographic + DAG fix; correction: confirmed correct and material (7.3x overstatement)
